description: SU(3) BMN-sector highest-weight Q-cohomology of the SU(3)_R column lam = (8,5,4) (j = 34, [3,1]) at every 2J: per sector the hw multiplicity m, rank r_up of Q from 2J+1, graviton rank grav (products of u_n, v_n, w_n, n <= 3, modulo exact), h = m - r_up(2J) - r_up(2J-1) and BH = h - grav; per column the Euler characteristic vs the exact index, the C-twisted index and the exact number of P-odd classes (R-017), the fused capacity of the SU(3) > SU(2) x U(1) restriction (R-016) and the resulting lower bounds on genuine SU(3) cores (fortuity.hwcoh.cores)
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agents) on Harvard FASRC
code: sectors: fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors with ENGINE=par (fortuity.hwcoh.sectorpar), MAXLEN=6, MAXLEN_UP=6, GEN_NMAX=3, SEED=1, via scripts/bmn/su3-cores/cluster/sector.sbatch; post-processing: fortuity.hwcoh.cores (core_test) via scripts/bmn/su3-cores/analysis/make_core_data.py
commit: post-processing code d88f5c3; sectors 2J=7,8,9 with the code of 61ed855 (job 49389620), 2J=6 with ac60633 or later (jobs 49515813/49516090), 2J=0-5 with the code synced on 2026-10-02 (resubmission with memmaps on global scratch); the engine mathematics is the same in all of them
conventions: D-006 (Chang-Lin / Choi et al. BMN conventions as in fortuity.bmn.words); sector (2J; q1,q2,q3), j = 2 sum q, E = sum q - J; rep [a,b] = [q1-q2, q2-q3]; P = C (-1)^Y
inputs: SU(2) non-graviton content: T-027 run_sectors output data/su2/hw_cohomology_j44_records/*.jsonl (commit c902a67; complete columns only; levels <= 17 can contribute); exact SU(3) dims: fortuity.hwcoh.dims.partition_dims_nf(3, 36) (dims_nf_su3_36.pkl)
checked: every sector: rank of the hw vectors at its functionals = exact multiplicity in every fermion degree, and every degree with a nonzero exact multiplicity has words (review B.4 guard, re-checked here for the runs made before it existed), so r_up and grav are exact over F_p; column: Euler characteristic 3 = exact index 3; (H_total - (-1)^|lam| I_C)/2 = (37 - 31)/2 = 3 P-odd classes = BH, as R-017 predicted (>= 3); the graviton total 34 equals R-017's Coulomb count D for this column; the fused capacity reproduces the R-016 channel of R-007 at (7,4,4) and the saturated j = 32 columns of T-042 (tests: code/tests/test_cores.py)
caveat: random evaluation over F_p (p = 2^26 - 5) with certified functionals: exact over F_p; a bad prime could only add classes (pairs), which would lower the P-odd count. Traces of length <= 6 (spanning certified per sector). Classical (tree-level) cohomology; non-graviton in the sense of D-005. The core bound is a count: which classes are the cores is decided by restricting explicit representatives (T-032 follow-up)
